Name: They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Extras
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
AuthorLabel: cresolyn and Dolphin Is Not a Fish
Description:
This mod aims to eventually give portraits to every extra who has dialogue in [i]Stardew Valley[/i].

Part of the [i]They Deserve It Too[/i] series, aiming to give portraits to various [i]SDV[/i] characters:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414][i]Portraits for Vendors[/i][/url]: Give portraits to vanilla vendors, also comes with various extra features.[/*]
[*][b][i]Portraits for Extras[/i][/b]: You are here![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37152][i]Portraits for Central Station[/i][/url]: Give portraits to all the tourists who visit the [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url][/i] by[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild] Pathoschild[/url].[/*]
[/list][size=6][b]L[/b][/size][size=5][b]atest Update[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44202][i]Stardew Valley Flower Show[/i][/url] by giving its tourists and vendor portraits, some of them new!
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/1249127-1776056179.png[/img][/*]
[/list][b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]F[/size][size=5]eatures[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]More than 40 custom dialogue portraits...[/*]
[*]... including portraitless characters who appear in events.[/*]
[*]Support for various mods that change extras' appearances.[/*]
[*]Options to give some extras consistent labels, or names.[/*]
[*]Fully configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/url].[/*]
[/list][b][color=#ffe599][size=6]M[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]ods Support[/color][/size]
Portraits for Extras[/b]  will automatically adjust its portraits when the following mods are installed:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1931][i]Ghostly Mariner[/i][/url]. Turn the Old Mariner into an obvious ghost, with dual color options![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14474][i]Glam Kitchen[/i][/url]. Make your cooking more GLAM with The Glam Kitchen![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35359][i]Jinu in the Casino[/i][/url]. It's Jinu from [i]KPop Demon Hunters[/i]! In the casino![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13002][i]Androgynous Kel[/i][/url]. Leah's ex is now less gendered![/*]
[/list]It also adds portraits for some extras featured in other mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6372][i]Stardew Aquarium[/i][/url]. Help restore the Stardew Aquarium to its former glory by donating fish for its exhibitions![/*]
[/list]You might also want to explore other mods that provide portraits for the extra characters:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23881][i]Give the Mermaid Her Pendant Back![/i][/url] Have a mermaid marketing the Mermaid's Pendant to you instead of the Old Mariner.﻿[/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8]﻿[b][size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿ installed and working.[/*]
[*]Download [b][i]Portraits for Extras[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]TDIT - Portraits for Extras[/font] from your Mods folder.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Only works with [i]SMAPI[/i] version 4.3.2 and later.[/*]
[*]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4668][i]Platonic Relationships[/i][/url], you'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284][i]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/i][/url] for event compatibilities.[/*]
[*]May conflict with mods that use Marcello, Kel, or MarILDA in an event. Please let me know if you find strange event behavior.[/*]
[*]No other mod incompatibility that I know of. Please inform me if you find any.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/color][/b]
This mod uses i18n. If you want to make or update a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).

[b][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]C[/size][size=5]redits[/size][/color][/b]
The majority of the default portraits in this mod were collaborative efforts by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/cresolyn?gameId=1303]cresolyn [/url]and I. The rest are works from various artists, including [url=https://twitter.com/AndiasRakhman]Andias Rakhman[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/257490523]Heart[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS?gameId=1303]Airyn[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ItsBenter?gameId=1303]ItsBenter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCP7rDkAMyVV28Xf600ywViw]Speedy[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url], to whom I'm grateful for adding their flair into the mix. A more detailed breakdown of credits for each file can be found in Credits.xlsx within the mod's assets folder.

[i]PortraitsForAll[/i], the C# portion bundled with the mod, was entirely written by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato?gameId=1303]mushymato[/url], whose work made the mod possible exactly as I imagined.
[url=https://github.com/Mushymato/PortraitsForAll][size=4]PortraitsForAll source code[/size][/url]
